🗳️ They just changed who gets to vote — and nobody asked you.

On 2 September MPs passed the Representation of the People Bill by 411 votes to 102. The voting age drops to 16 for Westminster and for local elections in England and Northern Ireland.

✅ The good bit: real action on foreign money, a £100,000 cap on overseas donations and a moratorium on crypto donations.

❌ The problem: a Parliament elected in 2024, under a Prime Minister the public never chose, rewriting the franchise in his second month in office.

Sixteen-year-olds can't buy a pint, sit on a jury, or stand for the council they'd be voting for. You're allowed to ask why the age only bends in one direction.
